title: perf(mobile): settings screens compile with the React Compiler
body:
Six settings screens were skipped by the React Compiler: About, Environments, Environment detail, Notifications, Project overview and Provider accounts. All six used `try`/`finally` or `try` without `catch`, so they shipped unmemoized.

Each screen now does its cleanup in `.finally()` on the promise. Where the awaited call is an atom command, the cleanup simply runs after the `await`, because atom commands settle into a result and never reject. The Notifications live-activity disable body moved into a named async function so the in-flight ref resets through `.finally()`. With the compiler covering these files, their manual `useCallback`/`useMemo` are gone. `KNOWN_BAILOUTS`: 84 → 78.

**Verified on device** (Pixel 9 API 36 emulator, dev client built from `main`, isolated seeded server):
- Environments: list renders, opened the connected environment's detail.
- Environment detail: **Check for updates** ran to "You are up to date". **Refresh providers** showed "Provider status refreshed."
- Project overview: picked a project from the settings filter, renamed it (title updated on save), then renamed it back.
- Provider accounts, About and Notifications render.
- No red box, and no `useMemoCache` or React errors in the Metro log.

**Renders while opening each screen from Home** (`measure-renders --route`, median of 3, same base and device):

| Route | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| `/settings/environments` | 1268 | 1268 |
| `/settings/notifications` | 720 | 620 |
| `/settings/about` | 886 | 886 |
| `/settings/provider-accounts` | 1045 | 1045 |

No measurable change on three of the screens: these are mount-and-settle windows, and the components barely re-render after mount. Notifications drops by one wrapper re-render pass (720 → 620 in 2 of 3 runs).

## Review follow-up

- Settings: `.finally`/`.catch` chains replaced. Commands (provider sign-in, project rename, cloud refresh, live-activity writers) are awaited, with the reset right after. `runAppUpdateCheck`, the environment action runner and `findEnvironmentUpdate` go through `settlePromise`. The provider-accounts `.catch(() => null)` is gone, because commands never reject.
- On device: environment detail → Check for updates and Refresh providers both complete and reset ("Provider status refreshed."). With the server stopped, the rows go disabled and no spinner is left running.

![Provider refresh succeeded](https://gh-file-drop-api-prod-mi5fy3sowv63ufte.pinglabs.workers.dev/f/4e837bf38519a391/rf-17.png) ![After stopping the server: rows disabled, no stuck spinner](https://gh-file-drop-api-prod-mi5fy3sowv63ufte.pinglabs.workers.dev/f/70c8268bdddea75c/rf-18.png)

Device: Pixel 9 API 36 emulator on nucbox-1, client rebuilt from `perf/mobile-compile-8` (the old one lacked the `T3FoldPosture` native view), Metro and an isolated seeded server on cups.

Claude Opus 5.5 via Claude Code.
